# Facebook Search Scraper

The Apify actor [`apify/facebook-search-scraper`](https://apify.com/apify/facebook-search-scraper) as typed Telo kinds, generated from its build **0.0.339**. The module's version is that build number, and every run it starts is pinned to exactly that build, so the input types below are the ones the actor really runs with.

Scrape Facebook search results: posts, pages, profiles and reels. Add a keyword and extract search results like pages details, profile information, recent posts or reels. Export scraped data, schedule via API, integrate with other tools or AI workflows.

## Pricing

Pay per event — Facebook result $0.006, Google result $0.012, Page or profile $0.012, Actor start $0.001 (Free-plan prices; paid plans pay less). Cap the spend with `maxTotalChargeUsd`.

Runs are charged to the Apify account whose token the `ApifyClient` holds. See the [Store page](https://apify.com/apify/facebook-search-scraper) for current prices.

## Import

```yaml
imports:
  Actor: oci://ghcr.io/telorun/apify/apify-facebook-search-scraper@0.0.339#sha256-…
```

Pin the digest with `telo upgrade`. The module re-exports `ApifyClient`, so it is the only import needed.

## Usage

```yaml
kind: Actor.ApifyClient
metadata: { name: apify }
token: !cel "secrets.apifyToken"
---
kind: Actor.Run          # or Actor.Start for runs longer than 5 minutes
metadata: { name: scrape }
client: !ref apify
maxTotalChargeUsd: 1     # optional: timeout, memory, maxItems, maxTotalChargeUsd
---
kind: Run.Sequence
metadata: { name: main }
steps:
  - name: scrape
    invoke: !ref scrape
    inputs:
      categories: []
```

- **`Run`** calls Apify's synchronous endpoint and returns `{ items }`. Apify holds the request open for at most 300 seconds; a longer run fails with HTTP 408.
- **`Start`** starts the run, long-polls it until it finishes, and returns `{ run, items }`. A run that ends `FAILED`, `TIMED-OUT` or `ABORTED` raises `APIFY_RUN_NOT_SUCCEEDED` with the run as `data`.

## Input

Only these fields are accepted — `telo check` rejects any other.

| Field | Type | Required | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `categories` | array | yes | `[]` | 🔍 Search terms — Add one or multiple keywords. You can add the keywords one by one, or use the Bulk edit section to pull them from a prepared list. |
| `locations` | array |  | `[]` | 📍 Location (applied to each search term) — Free text location definition. Just add a name of a country, city or province. |
| `searchType` | string |  | `"pages-google"` | 🔎 Search type — Choose the type of Facebook search data you want to scrape. Posts return both images and reels. |
| `resultsLimit` | integer |  |  | 💯 Up to [number] of search results — Set the number of results you expect for the entire run (if this limit is not set, as many results as possible are returned). |
